findings.summary: Planner revision envelopes include resolved findings forbidden by P-02
findings.evidence: src/context-envelope.test.ts:388-431 supplies F-RESOLVED and RESOLVED-CLEAR-CONDITION through both finding inputs, then asserts both markers are absent from the complete prompt and that resolved-findings is omitted from the manifest and evidence. src/context-envelope.ts:725-779 formats only OPEN findings and emits no resolved-finding artifact class. The authorized test:fast and heavy orchestrator gates passed for tree 359074422d14ec126e20e0f2e5f138ed1e865aa4.
findings.expected: Planner revision prompts and logical evidence exclude resolved finding content and resolved-finding artifact classes even when resolved history exists upstream.
findings.observed: Resolved input remains accepted for legacy callers but is ignored by assembly; the prompt contains neither seeded resolved marker and the evidence contains only current contract, open finding, control, gate, and migration classes.
findings.clearCondition: Planner revision prompts and evidence exclude resolved finding content and artifact classes even when resolved history exists upstream, with an assertion that a supplied resolved marker is absent.

findings.summary: Provider parity is asserted by reusing one preassembled evidence object
findings.evidence: src/context-envelope.test.ts:777-853 calls assembleGeneratorEnvelope separately inside the loop for Kiro-, Claude-, and Codex-named stubs, captures each normalized prompt and logical evidence independently, compares prompt bytes and evidence deeply, and asserts seeded B-01, tests, FINDING-09, and CHECKPOINT-07 identifiers. The authorized test:fast gate passed for tree 359074422d14ec126e20e0f2e5f138ed1e865aa4.
findings.expected: Each named stub receives an independently assembled envelope from the same logical input, and captured normalized prompts and logical evidence match while preserving every seeded stable ID.
findings.observed: Each adapter iteration now performs a fresh assembly before invocation; all three captured prompts and evidence objects are compared and all four stable-ID classes are asserted.
findings.clearCondition: Independently assemble and pass the same manifest/artifact input through each named stub, then compare their captured normalized prompts and logical evidence and assert all seeded behavior, gate, finding, and checkpoint IDs.

findings.summary: Per-invocation evidence tests do not assert all exact required values
findings.evidence: src/orchestrator.test.ts:2251-2488 asserts one prompt-assembly event per scoped invocation, exact prompt byte sizes against captured dispatch prompts, exact ordered included classes and IDs, exact omitted-class arrays, exact manifest metadata, tokenCounts field absence for explorer, and exact token maps for every other invocation including cache_read_input_tokens. The authorized heavy orchestrator gate passed for tree 359074422d14ec126e20e0f2e5f138ed1e865aa4.
findings.expected: Every scoped invocation has exact assembledByteSize, exact omittedArtifactClasses, and either the exact provider token map or an absent tokenCounts field, including at least one cache-read token name.
findings.observed: The full stub lifecycle now asserts exact evidence for all eight scoped invocations and includes cache_read_input_tokens with explicit field-presence and field-absence checks.
findings.clearCondition: Assert exact assembledByteSize and exact omittedArtifactClasses for every scoped event, expose a cache-read token name in at least one scoped stub result, and assert exact token maps or field absence for every invocation.
